caption: Tense, curious cinematic science-documentary underscore for a 30 second explainer short, 100 BPM, minor key. Low pulsing synth bass ostinato, soft staccato strings, deep muted piano notes, subtle ticking-free rhythmic pulse from low toms, slowly building tension, a dark swelling string and brass rise that breaks into one huge low cinematic impact and rumbling sub-bass near the end, then a held dark chord that decays. Sits under a calm spoken narrator. Warm, rounded high end, no harsh hats, no cymbals, no clicks, no vocals.
lyrics:
[Intro - low pulse, muted piano]

[Verse - staccato strings join, curious]

[Build - tension rises, low toms]

[Drop - huge low impact, rumbling sub-bass, dark brass]

[Outro - held dark chord decays]
chosen: seed61 — its impact (28.8 s into the take) is lined up with the music_sync cue (the eruption)
